title: Optional tool switching and flexible resize handles
summary: Choose whether clicking another object changes tools, and resize height or width independently with new edge handles.

Added: Edit > Automatically switch tools when selecting objects. This saved setting is off by default; enable it to select another annotation type and activate its tool and properties in one click.
Top, bottom, left and right midpoint handles alongside the existing corners. Ordinary edge drags preserve the other dimension, redraw live and commit with one Undo.
Preview: Alt-drag object bodies or selected groups to duplicate with live previews and one Undo. Alt on a handle instead resizes around the center.

Shift preserves resize proportions; Shift+Alt combines proportions with center resizing. Shift constrains line endpoints to 45-degree steps. These gestures pass automated input tests; physical held-key drag verification remains pending.
Verified: Native tool switching on/off, preference retention after restart, independent height resizing, one-step Undo/Redo and exact clipboard output from a reopened editable fixture.
Automated copying tests cover all 14 annotation kinds, selected groups, fresh identities, original preservation, snapping, persistence and atomic Undo.

limitations: The desktop inspection API cannot hold modifier keys during a drag. Alt-drag duplication and Shift/Alt resize remain flagged for physical gesture verification in the roadmap.
Complete core-tool options, Simplify, crisp vector zoom, editable autosave and toolbar ordering remain unfinished.
Movement and Step placement have object alignment snapping. Resize-to-object, grid and constrained new drawing remain pending.
